violated_contract: A D1 migration must be accepted by the remote migration transport as well as SQLite. Unparenthesized CASE expressions inside a trigger can be mistaken for the trigger terminator by the remote query parser, even when local migration and business tests pass.
canonical_prevention: Keep CASE expressions parenthesized in the affected frame triggers, retain a clearly labeled static portability tripwire in the existing route lane, and exercise fresh remote migrations with the actual Wrangler migration command. SQLite publication and erasure tests establish unchanged business semantics; they do not certify the remote parser.
